title: Plan · LiveLayer
description: What you do differently next time: recommendations on bars, payment terminals, staffing and vendor volumes – each with a value in kroner.

hero.sub: What you do differently next time. Concrete recommendations – each with a value in kroner, a reason and how confident we are.
ann: Pop-up bar by the main stage
Four fewer terminals at the entrance

ledger.h2: 11 recommendations. DKK 420,000 more on the bottom line.
ledger.p: The plan for 2027. You choose which recommendations to follow – and Relay remembers how they went, for next time.
items: Close the VIP bar at 20 on Sunday and move the volunteers
Move two volunteers from bar 2 to bar 5, Friday 18–20
Open the camping bar with two terminals until 21
Pop-up bar by the main stage after 23 on Saturday
Move the cider stock to bars 1 and 3 before Saturday night
Shorter menu on the food street, faster service
Rent four fewer terminals for the entrance bar
More cooling in the tent on Saturday
The camping coffee bar opens at 7 instead of 9

anatomy.p: We don’t just repeat last year’s clock times. We find the situations behind the queue – and predict when they will happen again.

rows.v: 3 more payment terminals at bar 4 when the situation occurs
A headliner in the tent for a 25–35-year-old crowd with high spending power that mostly buys draught beer and drinks. Demand peaks 30–90 minutes after the concert starts.
Two nights in 2027: Friday from 21:00 and Saturday from 22:00 – where the line-up draws the same crowd to the tent.
Line-up and genre · crowd age and spending power · what that crowd buys · ticket sales per day
Last year demand was 700 servings an hour in that situation. Capacity was 520.
The same pattern at two other festivals – adapted to your tent and crowd
High – the pattern repeated on both nights last year

staffing.p: Bar 4 on Saturday. Staffing follows the situations the crowd creates – predicted from the line-up, the crowd profile and what they buy. Six volunteers when the headliner fills the tent, two when it is quiet. The same number of shifts.

vendors.h2: Vendors get the numbers up front.
vendors.p: A range per vendor and day – with the full reasoning behind it. Choose a vendor and see how we get to the number.

terminals.h2: Payment terminals where the queues are.
terminals.p: More where the queues were. Fewer where capacity stood empty.

cta.h2: Get your own plan for next time.
